children: Macy's, Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $5.06B, net income of $169M and diluted EPS of $0.62, each improving versus the prior-year quarter as the retailer saw modest comparable-sales growth and margin benefits from tariff refunds.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Comparable sales were up 2.7% for the quarter and 2.8% year-to-date, with net sales rising roughly 1–1.5% driven by go‑forward locations and digital channels.
Digital sales remained about 31–32% of net sales, supporting omni‑channel fulfillment and productivity gains.
Brand strength was led by Bloomingdale's, which posted an 11.3% comp increase, and Bluemercury, up 6.2%; Macy's Reimagine 200 stores continued multi‑quarter growth.
Operational improvements included a 7% increase in units per hour and a 6.7% reduction in order‑to‑ship days; the company is investing in AI, automation and its Ask Macy's assistant.
Macy's received $116M in tariff refunds (including a $95M gross margin benefit) and is deploying those funds across investments and initiatives.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Macy's, Inc. Q2 2026: Revenue $5.06B, EPS $0.62— 10-Q Summary
